title: User-Defined Dynamic Database Schemas
pattern: Representing schema definitions, field layouts, and validation constraints as runtime collections (like arrays of `AttributeSchema`) rather than standard structures.
why_bad: It forces developers to write verbose, error-prone parsing and type-coercion routines. It shifts type checking from compile-time to runtime, leading to frequent crashes on schema modifications.
detection: Collections containing data types as enum variables (`DataType::String`), used to parse and validate field vectors.
counterexample: `Context-dependent`. General-purpose databases or CMS products where users define custom table structures dynamically via UI.
source: Edwin Brady - _Type-driven Development with Idris_ (2017, Manning Publications).pdf, Chapter 12.
